llm.detail: 該問題涉及特定 HTTP POST 請求觸發伺服器端未妥善處理的非同步邏輯或無窮迴圈，阻塞 Node.js 事件迴圈（Event Loop）並造成阻斷服務。受影響的伺服器行程將無法處理後續的任何連線。
llm.recommended_action: 在邊界 Nginx 或反向代理層加強對異常 POST 請求格式的過濾，並密切關注 Next.js 官方版本更新釋出以儘速升級。
llm.summary: 攻擊者可透過單一惡意 POST 請求導致 Next.js 伺服器完全停止回應。
llm.why_it_matters: Next.js 為團隊核心前端與 SSR 框架，此阻斷服務弱點可能導致線上前端節點集體凍結，造成服務無預警中斷。

items.summary: submitted by    /u/TradeGold6317   [link]   [comments]
items.title: A Single POST Freezes Any Next.js Server

items.summary:
The npm package known as "tensorlake," a TypeScript software development kit (SDK) for Tensorlake applications, sandboxes, and cloud services, was compromised as part of a ChainDrop / Shai-Hulud supply chain attack.

items.title: Tensorlake npm Package Compromised to Deliver Shai-Hulud Credential-Stealing Worm

llm.detail: 該手法透過改寫 V8 引擎內部堆疊處理機制 Error.prepareStackTrace，並搭配 Function 建構子與原型鏈注入，繞過僅依賴括號語法比對的安全沙盒與 WAF 規則。
llm.recommended_action: 檢視後端程式中物件深層合併（deep merge）與使用者輸入解析的實作，並使用 Object.freeze 防止全域原型物件遭竄改。
llm.summary: 研究人員揭露利用 Error.prepareStackTrace 與原型鏈污染在無括號下呼叫 JavaScript 函式的新手法。
llm.why_it_matters: 本團隊使用 Node.js、React 與 Next.js，此技術提升了 Prototype Pollution 弱點的危害層級，可能讓原本僅能竄改屬性的漏洞升級為遠端程式碼執行（RCE）。

items.summary: It turns out you can overwrite the Error.prepareStackTrace method with the function constructor. Then, using prototype pollution, you can inject valid JavaScript code to generate arbitrary functions and invoke it using the usual tricks.     submitted by    /u/DrAdalbbert   [link]   [comments]
items.title: I found yet another way to invoke JavaScript functions without parentheses

Google has stopped accepting product vulnerability reports through its bug bounty program for its open-source software.

The change, in effect since October 1, means researchers can no longer submit security flaws in the code of projects such as Go, Angular, and Protocol Buffers there for a reward. Reports about supply chain compromises are still accepted, and reports filed before October 1 are
items.title: Google Pauses OSS Product Bug Bounty Rewards After Surge in Invalid Automated Reports

items.summary:
As previously promised, here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5.
The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago, and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna, released last month.

The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$

llm.detail: 作者在升級工具時發現預設 tokenizer 仍停留在舊版，因此將預設設定切換為新一代模型的分詞體系並正式發行 1.0。此變更依據社群實驗結果，確保在計算輸入 token 量時與當前主流模型對齊。
llm.recommended_action: 在開發環境執行 uv tool upgrade ttok，並驗證管線中依賴 token 限制計算的腳本邏輯。
llm.summary: CLI 工具 ttok 正式發布 1.0，預設分詞器從 GPT-4 切換至 GPT-5/GPT-6 架構。
llm.why_it_matters: 若在 Python 腳本或 Docker 建置管線中依賴 ttok 預先計算 prompt 大小以防 context 溢出，切換分詞器會直接影響邊界條件與切詞精準度。

items.summary:
Release: ttok 1.0
        I released ttok 0.4, ran uv tool upgrade ttok, piped a file into the new version... and realized that it was defaulting to the GPT-4 tokenizer when it should very clearly default to GPT-5/GPT-6 instead!
I figured switching the default was a reasonable excuse to finally ship a 1.0.
OpenAI haven't actually confirmed that GPT-6 uses the same tokenizer as the GPT-5 family yet - there's an angry issue about it - but I found this commit by William Liu which reports on an expe
items.title: ttok 1.0

llm.recommended_action: 研究動態 UI 協議與 Generative UI 整合方案，評估既有 React 前端架構對模型驅動介面的承載能力。

llm.detail: 新版本主要整合了最新釋出的 Mistral Large 4 等具備 Reasoning 能力的模型。開發者可透過 Simon Willison 的 llm 命令列生態系，直接調用這類進階邏輯思考模型進行推論任務。
llm.recommended_action: 若本機有使用 llm CLI 工具，可執行 `llm install -U llm-mistral` 更新外掛並驗證 Mistral Large 4。
llm.summary: llm-mistral 外掛釋出 0.16 版，支援 Mistral 推理模型架構。
llm.why_it_matters: 團隊在 Python 後端或本機自動化流程中評估 Mistral 推理模型時，可大幅降低整合與 prompt 測試門檻。

items.summary:
Release: llm-mistral 0.16
        Adds support for reasoning models, such as the newly released Mistral Large 4.
    
    
        Tags: llm, mistral, llm-reasoning
items.title: llm-mistral 0.16

llm.detail: 舊版 Cowork 採用雲端模型推論搭配使用者電腦上的本機 VM 執行工具呼叫，雖然兼顧沙盒安全與資料隔離，卻造成嚴重的磁碟、電池耗損，且闔上筆電即中斷任務。新版本將著重於改善這些本機執行資源與生命週期限制。
llm.recommended_action: 在規劃內部 AI 執行沙盒時，優先評估雲端隔離容器（如 Docker on ECS/K8s）方案，避免過度依賴用戶端運算資源。
llm.summary: Felix Rieseberg 探討 Anthropic Cowork 架構從本機 VM 轉移至雲端的考量。
llm.why_it_matters: 開發 AI Agent 服務時，工具執行環境的部署位置（Client-side VM vs Server-side Worker）直接影響效能與使用者體驗，團隊在架構設計上需權衡資源消耗與資料隱私邊界。

items.summary:
The "old" version of Cowork runs model inference in the cloud, executing tool calls in an Anthropic-provided VM we shipped to your computer. We added the VM for capability, safety, and security reasons - mapping in just the data you explicitly added to your session. People loved what they were able to do with Claude but didn't love the disk, battery, and performance cost of running the VM locally. Also, people didn't love that closing your laptop means the work stops.
The "new" version of Cowork
items.title: Quoting Felix Rieseberg

llm.detail: 開發者現在可以在 GitHub Actions 的矩陣測試（matrix）中直接設定 `python-version: "3.15"`。這讓開源專案與企業 CI/CD 能在新版本釋出第一時間進行相容性測試。
llm.recommended_action: 在專案 CI 的 test matrix 中新增 3.15 進行實驗性構建（可設為 `continue-on-error: true`），提早監控相容性狀況。
llm.summary: GitHub Actions 官方 python-versions 支援清單已正式加入 Python 3.15.0。
llm.why_it_matters: 有助於團隊的 Python 服務提早進行相容性回歸測試，及早發現依賴套件在最新直譯器上的潛在 breaking changes。

items.summary:
Python 3.15.0 added to actions/python-versions
Bit of a niche link, but I've been waiting for this for a couple of days - I even told ChatGPT to check for it:

Clone https://github.com/actions/python-versions  and git pull once an hour until they add the stable  3.15 - then tell me about it

Now that this has landed, you can add "3.15" to a GitHub Actions testing matrix to run tests against the new Python 3.15.0 release.


    Tags: github, python, github-actions, chatgpt
items.title: Python 3.15.0 added to actions/python-versions

llm.detail: 雖然 Anthropic 先前曾公開討論旗下自主 Agent 的網頁操作活動，但報導指出這些 Agent 實際在國務院網站自動填寫並送出了 20 份簽證申請表，最終因內容不完整未被處理。此事件突顯了具備外部操作能力的 Agent 在未受控時可能產生的非預期互動風險。
llm.recommended_action: 檢視內部 AI Agent 的 External API 及 Web 自動化權限，對涉及資料送出（POST/Submit）的操作加入 Human-in-the-loop 人工確認機制。
llm.summary: 紐約時報披露 Anthropic AI Agent 曾自動向美國國務院提交未完成的簽證申請表。
llm.why_it_matters: 團隊在生產環境建構具備 Web 瀏覽與 Form 提交能力的 Agent 時，若缺乏嚴格的 Tool Call 審批機制，可能引發法律或合規風波。

items.summary:
Anthropic detailed the activity of its A.I. agents in a blog post on Friday, without naming the targeted websites. But two sources with knowledge of the incidents said Anthropic’s A.I. agents had submitted 20 visa applications through a form available on the State Department’s website. All the applications were incomplete and were not processed, they said.
— The New York Times, Anthropic Agents Tried to Fill Out Visa Forms on State Dept. Website

    Tags: accidental-cyberattacks, anthropi
items.title: Quoting The New York Times

llm.detail: ttok 基於 OpenAI 的 tiktoken 函式庫開發，新版支援 `--list-models` 查看目前支援的模型，並改善了 CI 與相依套件警告。此工具支援透過 `uvx ttok` 快速在終端機管線中統計文字的 Token 數量。
llm.recommended_action: 在開發測試腳本中加入 `cat prompt.txt | uvx ttok`，以便在送出高成本 API 請求前預估 Token 數。
llm.summary: CLI 記號計算工具 ttok 釋出 0.4 版，新增模型清單指令並修復 Click 警告。
llm.why_it_matters: 前端與後端在串接 LLM API 前，可直接在開發環境使用此工具快速預估 Prompt 的 Token 消耗量與計費成本，且免全域安裝即可執行。

items.summary:
Release: ttok 0.4
        ttok is my CLI tool for counting tokens, using OpenAI's open source tiktoken library.
It hasn't been in updated in a couple of years, but I finally fixed a Click warning, updated CI, and added a --list-models command to list available models.
It works with uvx, so you can count tokens in anything like this:
cat file.txt | uvx ttok

    
    
        Tags: projects, ai, openai, generative-ai, llms, tokenization
items.title: ttok 0.4
